mapper.select: SELECT /* getServiceInfoList */ C.COMD_CODE AS CATE_CODE , C.COMD_NAME AS CATE_NAME , S.VERS_NUMB , S.SVCI_TITL , S.SVCI_CNTN , S.UPDT_DATE , S.DPLY_DATE FROM TB_CODEXD C LEFT JOIN CT_SVINFO S ON S.CATE_CGRP = C.COMM_CODE AND S.CATE_CODE = C.COMD_CODE AND S.DPLY_YSNO = #{yes} WHERE C.COMM_CODE = #{cateCgrp} AND C.USEE_YSNO = #{yes} ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR , C.COMD_CODE

SELECT /* getServiceInfoDtl */ C.COMD_CODE AS CATE_CODE , C.COMD_NAME AS CATE_NAME , S.VERS_NUMB , S.SVCI_TITL , S.SVCI_CNTN , S.UPDT_DATE , S.DPLY_DATE FROM TB_CODEXD C JOIN CT_SVINFO S ON S.CATE_CGRP = C.COMM_CODE AND S.CATE_CODE = C.COMD_CODE AND S.DPLY_YSNO = #{yes} WHERE C.COMM_CODE = #{cateCgrp} AND C.COMD_CODE = #{cateCode} AND C.USEE_YSNO = #{yes}
